source: v92 feedback navigation acted only during a 0.2-second SHOOT intent; the finisher reverted to RECEIVE while strike phase remained active. Some aggressive arms collided with other G1s, so physical collision remains a hard gate.
hypothesis: A private, time-bounded shot-task commitment can keep the finisher's causal feedback navigation active across temporary RECEIVE/RUN_IN_BEHIND decisions without granting persistent possession or bypassing opponent contact.
interruption: The commitment clears immediately on any intent other than SHOOT, RECEIVE or RUN_IN_BEHIND, expires by its own maximum elapsed seconds, and acts only while the ball stays within 2.5 m. Every velocity delta remains <=0.25 m/s under the existing NavigationSlot.
paired_parent: v92 damped, same three consumed scenes with zero commitment
gate: All three six-body scenes safe, no robot-robot collision, clean real source/receiver foot transfer, no nonfoot ball contact, at least one new genuine later finisher foot shot >=2 m/s. Rank by later shot count, in-goal crossings, and joint margin; if none passes, reject this task-lease family.
interpretation: A training pass is only an internal SIM_ONLY navigation result; requires new frozen unseen local exam, then 4v4 continuous match before video promotion.
